parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description:
The maximum number of entries per page.

Valid values: 1 to 500.

Default value: 20.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the resource.

parameters.name: RelatedResourceFilter
parameters.description: The filter conditions for resources associated with the resource.
